title: Party
description: A non-government organization taking part in a contracting process - a tenderer, a supplier, a funder - with the roles it plays. Government participants are NOT duplicated here: the buyer and procuring entity are _core GovernmentOrganizations, referenced directly from the process, so one body never becomes two entities. A scheme-qualified identifier is required: a supplier known only by name cannot be joined across contracts or to a company register, and unjoinable supplier data is the main reason procurement transparency fails in practice.

@type.description: Always `Organization`, a real schema.org type - `Party` is schemaGov's name for this role, not a minted type schema.org needs to know about.

name.description: The party's legal or trading name.

identifier.description: At least one. Use an org-id.guide prefix for the national company register (org-id:GB-COH, org-id:US-EIN) or an LEI. This is the same pattern OCDS uses, so it crosswalks without transformation.

url.description: The party's own website, where one exists.
